author: Sega Jenesis
title: Hiring digital artists for custom Pokémon binder scenes
content: I’m on the hunt for digital artists! I’m planning to order some custom Pokémon card binders as holiday gifts, and I’d love to commission an artist to create a scene or two for them! Full illustrated Pokémon scenes, not just individual characters. This is a PAID commission. Still looking for one or two more as of follow-up. Contact via replies or DM.

author: Kate King Author
title: Seeking artist for two character art pieces for new book
content: I am looking for an artist who has availability right now to draw two pieces of character art. Anyone have an opening? Recs from authors are very welcome. Human artists only, absolutely no AI. Bots and clearly AI content will be blocked. Please only comment below do not DM me. Update: One piece is 2 characters, the other is 3. For unannounced new book. PA will review replies and reach out to selected artists.

author: nrfrh_azn
title: Looking for illustrator for YA fantasy novel book cover
content: Calling all fantasy illustrators! I’m looking for an illustrator for my upcoming YA fantasy novel. Think dark academia, ancient magic, mysterious towers and an elegant, atmospheric fantasy aesthetic. If you create fantasy book covers, I’d love to see your portfolio! Please DM me your artwork, rates and estimated turnaround time. Recommendations are welcome too!

author: Meg Humble Author
title: Looking for character artists for 2 full-body pieces (<£300)
content: I know imma regret this, but I’m looking for character artists who have space in November for 2 full body characters (no background needed) ideally for less than £300. No AI. No DMs. Authors please also rec people you have used! Contact by commenting on the post.

author: Not Ordr (Romance Author)
title: Seeking character artist for upcoming book with flexible payment
content: I'm looking for an artists that can do character art for my up coming book. And who's willing to work with me because money is tight.
